conviction_note: The FY operating-profit plan (3,200m) needs a record H2 of 2,903m against 1,638m last year, so a cut at this print is a live possibility (Fujiya cut at Q3 in FY2023 and held at Q3 in FY2024), but the shortfall has been computable since the July 短信, this name moved -1.06% on its 2023 Q3 cut and -0.87% on its 2024 Q3 hold alike, and the company's own July note points to an improving Q3 (beverage shipments above plan from June, cocoa costs easing), so the two findings roughly cancel and the scaled number is a small negative lean on a name whose prints have mostly been sold (10 of 14 reactions negative).
bar: Company FY2026 plan: sales 125,000m, OP 3,200m, ordinary 3,650m, net 2,100m, held on 2026-07-28 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260727500360.pdf). No 四季報 or IFIS number could be sourced and no analyst covers the name, so the market's own bar is unsourced; print_vs_bar is the expected FY OP outcome (~2,300-2,500m on the company's own H2 seasonality) against the company plan, and every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-23 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from baseline). 信用倍率 0.74 (kabutan page 2026-10-26 shows 0.74倍, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=2211), margin shorts exceed margin longs, which on a 株主優待 name into a December record date is largely cross-trade hedging rather than directional shorts. No options, no skew. 20d run-up +0.44%, 5d +1.0%.

findings.finding: Fujiya's held FY2026 OP plan of 3,200m implies H2 OP of 2,903m (+77% y/y) after H1 OP of 297m (12.5% progress against 47-53% at the same point in 2024-2025), while Q3 is seasonally a loss quarter (Q3 OP -314m in 2024, -133m in 2025) and the record Q4 OP is 1,771m (2025); a downward revision at this Q3 print has a direct company precedent (2023-10-24, OP cut 29% at the Q3 release) and a counter-precedent (2024-10-28, plan held at 21.5% Q3 progress, cut separately on 2025-01-27).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Next-session moves from Yahoo daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2211.T?range=5y&interval=1d): 2023-10-24 Q3 print with a 29% OP cut -1.06%; 2024-01-26 separate second cut -2.47%; 2024-10-28 Q3 print, plan held at 21.5% progress -0.87%; 2025-01-27 separate 36% OP cut -1.03%; 2026-07-28 H1 miss with plan held +1.25% (悪材料出尽くし). Cut or hold, this name has moved about 1% on the forecast line.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the H1 progress rate has been computable since 2026-07-28, and the stock trades at PER 31x on plan EPS 81.5, a multiple that only makes sense if holders already look past the plan. What is not in the price is the decision itself and its size; if the market expected no cut, a 25-30% cut would look like the 2023/2024 prints (about -1%); if it already holds a cut, a modest trim or a hold reads as relief, which is what the +1.25% after the July miss looked like.
findings.independence: Company precedent for cutting at Q3: https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/22110/140120231023569759.pdf (2023-10-24); for holding at Q3 and cutting in January: https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/22110/140120241012597517.pdf and https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/22110/140120250124555134.pdf. Quarterly OP series from https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2211. Same company, separate documents.

findings.finding: The company's own 2026-07-28 差異 notice says beverage shipments have run above plan since June with summer supply in place at the new natural-water bottling plant, 洋菓子 store traffic has been recovering since June on lower-price products and new-format stores, confectionery has a new sales channel from Q3, and chocolate raw-material costs are easing, so Q3 OP is likely to improve on last year's -133m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 prints moved -1.06% (2023), -0.87% (2024), -0.77% (2025-10-28) on the Yahoo bars; no Q3 has been a positive surprise in the sample, so there is no measured reaction to a better Q3.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the company's own guidance language and so sits inside what holders were told to expect, which is why it is sized small. What would be new is the Q3 number confirming it: a positive Q3 OP would be the first in the sample and would make the H2 plan look less hopeless; the flat tape (+0.44% over 20 days) says nobody has positioned for it either way.
findings.independence: Cocoa futures have fallen through 2026 (https://cropgpt.ai/cocoa-near-two-year-lows-on-surplus-ghana-cuts-farmgate-as-ivory-coast-buys-back-stocks, undated snippet, macro proxy); no company or counterparty document after July corroborates the Q3 trend.

outside_window.finding: If the plan is held at Q3 as in 2024, the FY cut is likely to come in a separate 業績予想の修正 in late January (2024-01-26, 2025-01-27 precedents), each followed by about -1% to -2.5%.

baseline_tension: The lean is flat (+0.04) and the run-up flat (+0.44%), so neither cuts against a small negative; the strongest positive the release could carry is a held plan with a positive Q3 OP (first in the sample) or a cut read as 悪材料出尽くし, as the +1.25% after the July miss was, and I looked for returns (buyback, 増配, 優待) and found none.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信): guidance finding cut from -0.5 to -0.3 and p_up moved 45 -> 47; it was not taken to zero because the release can add the forecast decision itself.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension and confirmed I had looked for returns; the positive Q3 finding was left standing at +0.3.
